notes:
## Design Aesthetics and Materials
- The remote control design will feature a modern, curved shape with round corners and soft materials.
- The color scheme will be black and yellow, with the Real Reaction logo on the front.
- The front of the remote will be transparent to allow for different colored fronts or replacement parts.
- Buttons will be integrated into the surface on one level, not protruding.
- The remote control case will be made of hard plastic with a 2D curved shape.
- The remote control shape will be mostly square with rounded corners.
## Internal Components and Power
- The remote control will use rechargeable batteries as the energy source.
- The remote control will use a regular (second most expensive) chip.
- The LED backlighting will use multiple colors (blue, red, green) and the case will be transparent or semi-transparent to allow the light to show.
## Controls and Layout
- The volume control will be a scroll wheel located on the side of the remote.
- The scroll wheel will be yellow and small.
- The channel switch buttons will be placed vertically above and below the number display.
- Frequently used buttons (like channel switching) will be placed on the top, while less used buttons will be on the bottom.
## Advanced Features and Product Strategy
- Speech recognition will be included, requiring an advanced chip and microphone.
- The team decided to include the voice response feature where the device answers after a user command.
- Five versions of the product will be launched.
- A docking station will be designed for the remote control.
tldr: The team finalized the design of a new remote control with a modern, mostly square shape with rounded corners, a black and yellow color scheme, and a transparent front. Key features include a side-mounted yellow scroll wheel, rechargeable batteries, and speech recognition with a voice response feature. Five product versions will be launched.
